description: This Java class implements a mapping function for incoming external messages to Ditto protocol messages using embedded JavaScript code via Rhino engine. It facilitates message translation by executing a JavaScript function on the message payload and headers, converting the result into Ditto's internal adaptable objects.

classes.name: ScriptedIncomingMapping
classes.description: Implements a message mapping function that uses JavaScript (via Rhino engine) to transform incoming external messages into Ditto protocol messages. It executes a JavaScript function named 'mapToDittoProtocolMsgWrapper' defined in the scripting context.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Executes the JavaScript mapping function on an ExternalMessage, handles the output which may be a single object or an array, and converts it into a list of Adaptable objects. Catches Rhino exceptions and wraps them as MessageMappingFailedException.

methods.name: mapExternalMessageToNativeObject
methods.description: Converts an ExternalMessage instance into a Rhino NativeObject with headers and payloads (text and byte), suitable for passing into the JavaScript mapping function.

methods.name: getAdaptableFromObject
methods.description: Converts a JavaScript result object into a JSON string, then into a JsonObject, and finally into a Ditto Adaptable using ProtocolFactory.
